## 2

I understand why some images can seem suspicious, especially when they’re edited or digitally processed. But the evidence for a round Earth doesn’t depend on space photos alone: ships disappear hull-first over the horizon, Earth’s curved shadow appears during lunar eclipses, different stars are visible at different latitudes, and satellites and GPS work using models that account for Earth’s shape. These observations come from many independent sources.

## 3

Sunlight looks white, but it is made of many colors. When sunlight enters Earth’s atmosphere, it bumps into tiny air molecules. Blue light gets scattered in all directions more strongly than most other colors, so blue light reaches our eyes from across the sky. At sunrise and sunset, sunlight travels through more atmosphere, scattering away much of the blue and leaving more red and orange light.

## 4

雨落在深夜的城市里，像一层细密的帘子，遮住了远处的灯火。街道被水洗得发亮，霓虹倒映在积水中，随着车轮驶过，碎成一片片摇晃的颜色。窗外偶尔传来汽车经过的声音，随后又归于安静。屋檐滴水有规律地敲着，仿佛时间也放慢了脚步。空气里有泥土和湿树叶的气味，让人想起久远而温柔的记忆。有人撑伞匆匆走过，背影渐渐融进雨幕，整座城市像在一场安静的梦里沉睡。
